title: Step 62-A canonical handoff, live guard and Compare/Wishlist scope freeze
description: Documentation/governance-only Stage A for Step 62. Verify the live canonical handoff after Step 61 and Graphify operationalization, freeze Compare & Wishlist scope against Step 63+, register the A-I execution plan and acceptance gates, inspect existing Compare/Wishlist backend and Storefront readiness, and keep runtime implementation forbidden until protected merge and exact-SHA post-merge verification pass.

dependencies.name: Product Detail & Rich Media final canonical closure
dependencies.evidence: Step 61 stages A-I canonically closed; Stage-I protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release are recorded in CURRENT-STATE.

dependencies.name: Graphify operational layer and lifecycle integration
dependencies.evidence: Main includes Graphify operational layer plus Watch lifecycle integration through PRs #283, #287 and #288. Canonical graph output is repository-local and ignored by Git; connector-side Stage-A discovery therefore uses the committed graph operational contract plus focused source verification. Runtime mutation remains forbidden until a local executor records FRESH/PASS graph health and query/path/explain evidence.

evidence.graph_tooling_state: CANONICAL_OPERATIONAL_TOOLING; live local graph artifact not exposed by GitHub connector

discovery.compare_backend: POST /compare/validate and POST /compare exist; CatalogQueryService.compare enforces 1..4 unique products and one primary category, and returns comparable specifications with authoritative pricing.
discovery.wishlist_backend: GET/POST/DELETE /customer/wishlist exist behind CustomerOnly; CustomerWishlistService enforces active customer ownership, product existence, idempotent add/remove semantics, audit/outbox, and repository uniqueness.
discovery.frontend: Step 55/57 design artifacts define compare selection/table and wishlist states, while Step 60/61 runtime explicitly left Compare/Wishlist for Step 62.
discovery.migration_need: No evidence of a new migration requirement at Stage A.
discovery.dependency_need: No evidence of a new dependency requirement at Stage A.

acceptance_criteria.description: Live main, Step 61 closure, Current State, Roadmap, open PRs, Step 62 branches, Linear HOS-66 and relevant terminal Locks are inspected; Step 62 is proven NEXT / NOT_STARTED at the Stage-A baseline.
Step 62 A-I plan and exact Compare/Wishlist IN boundary are frozen; Cart/Checkout and later account/wholesale scope remain reserved for Steps 63+.

Existing backend readiness is recorded: Compare already enforces 1..4 unique same-primary-category products and authoritative comparable specifications/pricing; Wishlist is customer-owned, authenticated, idempotent and backend-authoritative. No backend rewrite is authorized by Stage A.

Graphify tooling is confirmed canonical. Because the canonical graph artifact is local and ignored by Git, Stage A records connector-visible graph tooling evidence and requires FRESH/PASS health plus query/path/explain evidence before any runtime mutation in Stage 62-B or later.
Persian fa-IR RTL, integer Toman, no Wallet, no brown palette, backend authority, accessibility, responsive and fail-closed contracts remain binding.

Stage 62-A remains documentation/governance-only; changes are restricted to the handoff document, Task Contract and deterministic generated Task Catalog; no runtime, dependency, backend, API, DB, migration, permission or business-rule mutation is introduced.

Canonical completion requires exact-head verification, Phase A and Merge Policy PASS, artifact-bound REVIEW/LOCK evidence, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification before 62-B may mutate runtime/API.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 62-A is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write and raw merge are prohibited. Step 62-B is forbidden until 62-A protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green and the 62-A Lock is terminally RELEASED.
